notes: A seven-match roleplay-judged card, one Tag Title match billed (Ktulu & Hardcore Craig challenging the reigning Secret Service, Matt Cross & Will James). Every entrant is billed only (THE BILLED APPEARANCE) — a booking sheet, not a results page; no outcome survives for any listed match. The page's own closing line points readers to the fed's own RP Board for an in-character account of the bookings, credited to an individual whose name is redacted here per the privacy rule (ambiguous between an in-fiction and out-of-fiction credit).
